The MTFS gap rises to GBP 4.649m cumulative by 2030/31.

District scope: no adult social care, children's or DSG demand to manage, but a thin GBP 21.3m budget with limited reserves (minimum GBP 2.225m) and a heavy GBP 110m capital programme (Town Deals) carrying delivery + borrowing risk. Reform inherits a Conservative-set budget; the first Reform-set budget is 2027/28.
Temporary accommodation is a GBP 194k cost pressure; homelessness demand is the main district social pressure (the council holds no HRA stock).
